title: DCP Multi-Wire Correlated Z-Fault Syndrome-Parity Walsh-Hadamard Twirl Bridge
claims: Under any joint Z-fault distribution p(e) on {0,1}^h, every CNOT-star syndrome branch d in {0,1}^{h-1} has exact conditional visibility hat_p(1^h) = E_{e ~ p}[(-1)^{e_0 xor ... xor e_{h-1}}].

Even-weight correlated Z-faults achieve noiseless conditional visibility hat_p(1^h) = 1.0 despite zero single-wire marginals, whereas a 50/50 mixture of wt=0 and wt=1 faults collapses hat_p(1^h) to 0.0 despite (1 - 1/h) marginals.
